steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Start with the ignition off and press the brake and accelerator pedals.
Turn the key to the accessory position, or press the START/STOP button once quickly. Do not start the engine.
Keep both pedals fully pressed for about 20 seconds, until the cluster shows ENGINE OIL CHANGE DUE NEXT SERVICE with a light.
Turn the car off. The message and light clear.
oil.note: Checked in the 2011 Fiesta owner's guide.

steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Start with the ignition off, then turn the key to ON, or press the START/STOP button once quickly without touching the brake. Do not start the engine.
Press the accelerator and brake pedals fully and hold them for about 20 seconds.
The display shows ENGINE OIL CHANGE DUE NEXT SERVICE with the oil light.
Turn the car off. The message and light clear.
oil.note: Checked in the 2013 Fiesta owner's guide.

steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the key to ON without starting the engine. With push-button start, hold the start button for two seconds without touching the brake.
Press the accelerator and brake pedals down together and keep both fully pressed.
After about three seconds the display shows that the oil reset is in progress. Keep holding.
After about 25 seconds it shows the reset is complete. Let go of both pedals.
Turn the ignition off (press the start button again on push-button models).
oil.note: Checked in the 2014 and 2015 Fiesta owner's manuals.
